# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Charts — 5 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 40 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 11 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Z index — 7 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--background);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the lime value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-greeting);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `greeting` | `.greeting`, `--text-greeting` | 60px / 1 | 700 | `display` | Spaces hero greeting. Uppercase except the user name; 36px on phones. Class: tb-type-name text-4xl sm:text-6xl uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none. |
| `page-name` | `.page-name`, `--text-page-name` | 60px / 1 | 700 | `display` | Space hero and mixer title, as typed (never uppercased). 30px phones, 48px tablet. Class: tb-type-name text-3xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none. |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-0-5);
```

### Tokens (11)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-0-5` | 2px | Gap between waveform pills (gap-[2px]); 3px on phones. |
| `space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gaps in toggles, row action gaps. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Inline gaps, meta gaps, menu item padding (py-2). |
| `space-3` | 12px | Button horizontal padding (px-3), row vertical padding (py-3), stat cell padding on phones. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Row horizontal padding (px-4); the 16px micro grid and the landing phone gutter. |
| `space-5` | 20px | Space card padding (p-5) and its block gaps (mb-5, mt-5). |
| `space-6` | 24px | Header and footer side padding (px-6), dialog padding (p-6), stat cell padding on desktop. |
| `space-8` | 32px | Error-screen card padding; the landing desktop gutter. |
| `grid-master` | 40px | Master grid of brand backgrounds. |
| `header-h` | 56px | App header height (h-14); landing header is 48px on phones, 56px from 992px. |
| `touch-target` | 40px | Minimum size of anything tapped on a phone: play, Quick peek, the menu button, M/S. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-none) */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-none` | 0px | Default for everything: cards, buttons, inputs, avatars, dialogs. The system is square. |
| `radius-sm` | 2px | The base --radius (0.125rem); barely softens a corner where a component library needs one. |
| `radius-md` | 6px | Listed in the kit; not used by product components. |
| `radius-lg` | 10px | Listed in the kit; not used by product components. |
| `radius-pill` | 9999px | Only waveform pills, status dots and the volume knob. |
